description: Compose a shared group into an application environment, so that environment resolves the group's secrets as well as its own. Safe to repeat — composing an already-composed group just updates its position. Use uncompose_group to undo, and list_env_groups to see the current order. When app access or sync requires new wrapped keys, use the local CLI to compose the group; this remote tool cannot wrap keys. Returns the composed { groupId, slug, name, position }.

app.description: Application slug or id, as returned by list_apps (e.g. "storefront").

env.description: Environment slug or id within that application, as returned by list_envs (e.g. "production").

group.description: Shared-group slug or id, as returned by list_groups (e.g. "shared-datastores").

org.description: Organization slug or id. Omit it when the credential can reach exactly one org — that org is used automatically. With several, the error names every slug you may pass; list them yourself with list_orgs.

position.description: Precedence among the environment's composed groups: on a name clash the HIGHER position wins, and the environment's own secrets beat every group. Omit to append at the end. Read the current order from list_env_groups first.

name: compose_group
